user.title: Add a shopping catalog
user.description: Each catalog is a JSON file with its own sensor, such as one per store. Point a Shopping List Card in Catalog mode at the sensor.

data_description.name: For example Costco. Trader Joe's creates sensor.shopping_catalog_trader_joes.
data_description.source: New catalogs are saved in the shopping_catalogs folder of your configuration directory.

existing.title: Use an existing JSON file
existing.description: Enter a path inside your configuration directory. The file keeps its current content and is edited in place.

data_description.path: Relative to the configuration directory, for example shopping_items.json.
